steps.title: Singleton: one shared instance
steps.text: `Singleton.getInstance()` creates the instance on the first call and keeps it in a closure, so every later call returns the same object. That is the first console line, `true`.
steps.textZh: `Singleton.getInstance()` 第一次调用时创建实例并保存在闭包里，之后每次调用都返回同一个对象。这就是控制台第一行的 `true`。

steps.title: Nothing stops new
steps.text: The pattern relies on callers using `getInstance()`. `new Singleton()` still makes a second object.
steps.textZh: 这个模式依赖调用方使用 `getInstance()`。`new Singleton()` 照样会创建第二个对象。

action.run: console.log('new Singleton() === getInstance():', new Singleton() === Singleton.getInstance())

steps.actionLabelZh: 比较 new Singleton() 和 getInstance()

steps.title: Adapter: the method callers expect
steps.titleZh: 适配器：提供调用方需要的方法
steps.text: `Target` holds a `Plug` and offers the `getName()` its callers expect, built on the plug's own answer. Callers never touch `Plug`.
steps.textZh: `Target` 持有一个 `Plug`，并基于插头自己的结果，提供调用方需要的 `getName()`。调用方从不直接接触 `Plug`。

steps.title: A read-only property
steps.text: `Object.defineProperty` with `writable: false` makes `name` read-only, so `Reflect.set` reports `false`, the second console line. In strict mode, a plain assignment throws instead.
steps.textZh: `Object.defineProperty` 配合 `writable: false` 让 `name` 变成只读，所以 `Reflect.set` 返回 `false`，也就是控制台第二行。在严格模式下，普通赋值会直接抛错。

action.run: try { test.name = 'replacement' } catch (error) { console.log('strict-mode assignment threw a', error.name) } console.log('name is still', test.name)

steps.title: The factories run in Node
steps.titleZh: 工厂示例在 Node 里运行
steps.text: The two factory examples have no page. From the repository root, `node mechanisms/design-patterns/factory/simple-factory.js` prints `yck`.
steps.textZh: 两个工厂示例没有页面。在仓库根目录运行 `node mechanisms/design-patterns/factory/simple-factory.js`，会打印 `yck`。
